decision_semantics.zero_po_price: Only zero invoice price/net is eligible; never divide by zero.
decision_semantics.receipt_selection: Explicit selected quantities sum exactly to invoice quantity; otherwise exactly one eligible positive-capacity receipt must exist and have sufficient capacity. Multiple positive-capacity candidates require selection even if only one could satisfy the full quantity.
decision_semantics.conflict_precedence: Remove invoices with any individual hold first. On remaining eligible invoices, compute receipt and PO demand simultaneously; hold all participants on every oversubscribed resource. No same-run retry after capacity is freed.
decision_semantics.atomicity: Any line held means all allocation proposals for that invoice are withheld.
decision_semantics.unsupported_nonzero_components: Nonzero charges, discounts, tax, or freight cause explicit unsupported-scope invoice hold before applying zero-component line formula, not silent omission. Declared header must still equal declared line-net sum.
decision_semantics.approval: Approved synthetic controls allow classification only; AP manager and source-owner decisions remain pending.

Review discrepancies and pending changes without charging clients

scenarios.bounded_scope: Marginal annual asset-value fee schedules, constant explicit synthetic value intervals, engagement proration, and exact draft comparison; no actual customer data.
scenarios.end_state: Complete fee-segment and draft-variance packet, comparable-population totals, unresolved evidence and pending sign-off; no debit, trade, investment advice, or regulatory opinion.

data_sources.name: engagements
data_sources.constraints: Synthetic IDs; active_from inclusive, active_to exclusive or null.

data_sources.constraints: Exactly one approved known-by-as_of schedule per active day. Pending never overrides; approved overlap is contradictory.

parameters.policy_label: Entire marginal formula, 365/366 basis, effective-change handling, rounding, thresholds, and rates are invented policies, not SEC requirements or IBKR implementation.

rules.description: Treat billing basis and separate value/rate ranges as explicit process inputs; the retrieved vendor example uses252, not this sample365/366.
Pending fee configuration is not treated as effective, consistent with the limited vendor statement; no real consent inferred.
Half-open active/schedule/value segments with exactly one approved known-by-as_of schedule and value per billable day; gaps hold, authoritative overlaps reject.
Slice value across contiguous marginal bands; first lower bound0 and final unbounded band; no whole-balance cliff or household aggregation.
Include opening day and exclude termination/end day; split calendar years for actual365/366 or explicitly select act-365-fixed.
Sum exact rational segment fee units and round once per account/period with explicit half-up or half-even.
Exact account/period/currency join, signed draft-minus-computed delta, inclusive tolerance; missing/duplicate drafts are not zero or arbitrary winners.
Separate comparable totals from missing-draft/uncomputed populations; preserve pending changes and output review only.

decision_semantics.approval_as_of: Approved_at must be <= as_of; approved metadata is synthetic evidence only.
decision_semantics.intervals: Half-open local calendar dates; opening included, termination/effective-end excluded; missing coverage holds account; approved or value overlap rejects case.
decision_semantics.pending_change: Visible pending flag; it cannot supersede an otherwise complete approved schedule.
decision_semantics.tiers: Start at0, strictly increasing finite upper bounds, final unbounded band; apply marginal slices, not last rate to entire value.
decision_semantics.rounding: Nonnegative exact half cent rounds upward in half-up and to the even cent in half-even; never round individual days or segments to cents.
decision_semantics.draft_join: Require exactly one account/period/currency draft for comparison; duplicate draft IDs are technical rejection, distinct IDs with duplicate business key are an account hold. Orphan/wrong-period/wrong-currency drafts remain explicit exception rows; optional draft schedule label cannot override approved temporal evidence.
decision_semantics.variance: draft_minor-computed_minor; positive overstatement, negative understatement, abs(delta)<=tolerance is within sample policy.
decision_semantics.totals: Comparable accounts only for draft-versus-computed delta; separately show computed-but-missing-draft and uncomputed populations.
